notes.title: Echo Storm - Update 1.4.2 is here!
notes.content:
Hi, it's been a while since we've had an update! Unfortunately, I haven't gotten over the marketing and the game is barely selling - there was no way to fund development.

Things are easier now, so I'll keep releasing updates and improving the game if possible.

Today I have a small update, which doesn't change the game much, but brings a lot of new internal improvements. 
In general - some art has been improved, bugs have been fixed, Chinese language has been added, map editor is now available (very early version).

Changelog:
- Environment details were added to the all locations
- Chinese localization added
- Disable screen shake option added
- Minor bug fixes
- Fixed some visual flicker problem
- Localization problems fixes
- Moved to a newer engine version, some inner code improvements
- Base planet buildings received a bit of visual rework.
- Menu visuals improved.
- Mods support extended: added Enemies Health Scale parameter
- Added support of "-map_editor" launch parameter to start Map editor on game launch
- Map editor now supports map background change (all game planets backgrounds included)
- Map editor font replaced with more readable font
- Map editor now supports creating a new map. Previously only loading of existing maps was supported
- Fixed map editor GameStartPoint and some other entities not worked
- Fixed map editor playing music from fight

notes.title: Update 1.4.1 released!
notes.content:
Hi! Today's update mostly contains minor improvements in the game visuals and readability of some effects, as well as small fixes.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- First Leviathan attack projectile and shoot effects were reworked to be more visually "readable". Also done some balance changes.
- First leviathan animation effect was added.
- Added new decorations for Kratea planet.
- Improved sand planet effects.
- Fixed some problem places on several planets.
- Fixed clouds effect on all planets, improved cloud sprite.
- Fixed abilities descriptions mistakes.
- Fixed minor UI bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 released!
notes.content:
Hi! The update for Echo Storm is ready! The update includes a new planet with its own Leviathan, a few new enemies, new weapon, and done some work on the game balance. I hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/cc74479f97f26147b16eea04dbef2cc9580bcd94.gif[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added new planet Kratea! It is a dangerous world with very aggressive enemies.
- Added new Leviathan for the new planet Kratea!
- Added two new enemies, one of them have attack fire debuff, so be careful on Kratea.
- Enemies spawn was reworked. Now enemies do not spawn infinite time on each area - now, you can fully clear area before going to bossfight. Spawn on different areas now has different enemies.
- Added some new music!
- Added new Machinegun weapon with rapid attack speed.
- Added distortion effect to the explosions.
- Increased damage for abilities with Return Damage buff.
- Changed some balance to make game faster a bit.
- More screen shake effect impact on grenades explosions.
- Fixed bug with teleport at the second Leviathan arena.
- Fixed lightning on fourth planet.
- Some work was done on supporting NPC modifications (for players mods). It still in progress, but mod base was partially completed for future updates.

Working on this update took longer than I expected, and I'm finally ready to release it. Not as much content has been added as I would have liked, but I've been able to work on the game inner systems to make them more flexible - it will simplify the development process. 

Thank you for patiently waiting for this update!

notes.title: Update 1.3.2 released!
notes.content:
I'm still working on content, and in the meantime a small patch has been made with fixes and improvements. Improved controls when playing with gamepad.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Some abilities texts were not shown with stats numbers.
[*] Gamepad aim was improved a lot. Hope it will now feels better.
[*] Added Gamepad Sensivity parameter to the Settings menu.
[*] Other minor changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.1 released!
notes.content:
The update is aimed at fixing the problems in version 1.3.0, but was also added new content in the form of new weapons and enemies, as well as made small improvements in general.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/717a8bbc7c7d441271df9a2820ab2d21b4d1951a.gif[/img]
Look at the new weapon in slow-motion :)

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: player characteristics numbers in Pause Screen sometimes were wrong (For example, Reload Speedup text was fixed and now it is Reload Time).
[*] Added the new weapon - Rocket gun. It shoots rockets with a small radius damage. Rockets affected by gravity and falling down with time.
[*] Added the new flying melee enemy. It have poison attack, so be careful!
[*] Wave Gun now shoots better, previously attack pattern was hitting floor periodically.
[*] Refinery now limited day resources extraction.
[*] Loadout shop prices were balanced and reduced a bit.
[*] Enemies spawn balance were changed a bit for game time before 5 minutes.
[*] Added buffs and debuffs info on the user interface.
[*] Modding now supports several sprites for Projectiles to use it as animation, and soon same thing will be supported for a weapons.
[*] Other code fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 released!
notes.content:
In this update, I tried to do some work on improving the sense of progression for the player and add more game content. New Base Build mode allows you to improve your character's stats, and they will apply to all subsequent game matches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/f557637a8e3ec488cca675647a5d5a36a15a5c75.gif[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Sometimes ally drones and other NPCs does not attacked enemies.
[*] Fixed: Sometimes ally turrets stopped attack enemies (when looking down).
[*] Fixed: If you're find teleport after its activation, Objective text was shown with the wrong info.
[*] Added Base Build mode! It allows you to create and upgrade buildings, which will permanently improve your characteristics, earn extra resources and more!
[*] Added a new planet for Base Build mode. It is safe, no one will attack you there (for now... :)).
[*] Added a character stats in the pause menu. Now you can get more info about your "build" effectivity.
[*] Added the new weapon "Wave Gun"!
[*] Map Editor fixes and improvements. Map Editor is still not available for public use, development in progress.
[*] Settings screen in the Pause menu now have better contrast with other interface.
[*] Other fixes and improvements.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 released!
notes.content:
With updates, we aim to increase the depth of gameplay and increase the amount of content available. This update focuses on these things. A new planet with its own Leviathan, new mechanics, and more are in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/5c0dfcf56759c8bb744e1b4e1bf6242313134eb9.png[/img]

- Added [b]Critical Damage Chance[/b] mechanic. Character critical chance can be modified by abilities and character’s characteristics itself.
- Added [b]Knowledge Totem[/b] mechanic. Now you can find a new abilities, which will drop in random in future «runs».
- Added some [b]new abilities[/b], which can be unlocked with Knowledge Totem.
- Added [b]new planet[/b] with a sand environment and new enemies waves.
- Added [b]new Leviathan[/b] for the new planet.
- Added death effect on character die, it allows player better understand when him was eliminated, when there a lot of enemies, it can be helpful to understand, what happened.
- Added a [b]new NPC[/b] type, you can meet it closer to a late game.
- Grapple Hook was balanced a bit.
- Better projectile effect for enemies on a first location.
- Better Leviathans healthbar.
- Some music effects were added to make playing more comfy.
- Some game optimizations were made.
- Minor code improvements.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2 released!
notes.content:
Update mainly aimed to improve gamepad controllers support and fixes. Also keyboard layout change support was added.

Please note, that Dualshock controller can be used in game now, but it still have some problems due to technical limitations. Connect it before you run the game to get it work correctly.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Jump platform can not work sometimes when you have Level points.
[*] Dualshock gamepad controller support improved a lot.
[*] Overall controllers support improved a bit.
[*] Into the Settings was added possibility to change Abilities keys layout. So, now you can select abilities controls keys, which you like more (qwert, 12345, zsxcv - available variants).
[*] Aim cursor is now hidden in pause menus.
[*] On pause now can not be used any abilities by such button press.
[*] When playing with mouse and keyboard, there is Hardware Aim cursor now, which reduces input lag.
[*] Segmented Worm NPCs now don't attack from below the ground in the first time. It makes easier to evade/attack them.
[*] Added some new visual decorations on the maps.
[*] Inner changes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 released!
notes.content:
This update is mainly aimed at improving and fixing version 1.1.0. Also the abilities of the Freeze technology have been expanded and improved, now it is very good branch to control enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/c5ed4a3091b71ab4f5f752836a8d53eedd3bf58c.gif[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Summon Plague Monsters ability can not be dropped in random sometimes.
[*] Fixed bug: New flying melee enemy previously can fly through walls sometimes.
[*] Fixed a lot of other minor bugs.
[*] Added new abilities and mechanics for them. Some actual abilities were changed a bit.
[*] Balance improvements: game start now easier, but with time it gets more hard, than before.
[*] In settings was added parameter, which enables corpse effect cleaning, it makes levels more clean and easier to play, if you don't like a lot of corpse effects.
[*] Added the new achievement.
[*] Added the new freeze effect for enemies.
[*] New visual environment details were added.
[*] Reroll mechanic was balanced a bit. 
[*] Nanomachines and Advanced Nanomachines abilities were balanced a bit.
[*] Improved Video settings screen, fixed bugs and added new parameters.
[*] Plasma moon weapon was balanced. Again. :)
[*] Minor user interface edits.
[*] Some modding improvements - support of loading custom map was added, etc. Actually it can not be used to make user maps, but in future updates it will be more useful.
[*] Inner code improvements and a lot of other undocumented changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 released!
notes.content:
This update is not very big, but it is released under the number [b]1.1.0[/b] - so we draw a line under all the updates released in the last month, which greatly transformed the game. Let's go over the key changes of all these updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/0120c7a292be6a527d8347d902016aaf75545a31.gif[/img]

[h2]Skills[/h2]
Many new abilities have been added, and many of the old ones have been redesigned and balanced. Abilities are now distributed into branches and can unlock new abilities.

Also ability selection screen was reworked to be more informative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/4206c13b7be846374c4ac615604a8cb9207ae16b.png[/img]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
Weapons, enemies, and abilities have been better balanced.
Spawn of enemies and their balance has been completely redesigned and should now feel better than it did before.

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
New types of enemies with their own gameplay features have been added. The AI of both allied NPCs and enemy NPCs has been improved.

[h2]Maps[/h2]
Maps have been redesigned, expanded and improved. Bonus item boxes have been added to the maps.

[h2]What's Next[/h2]
We continue to work on improving the game and new content. We plan to focus on variety and replayability of the gameplay.

[h2]1.1.0 Changelog[/h2]
Especially for 1.1.0, for previous versions check previous posts.
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Previously, on Gamepad controller claim button on the Bonus Take screen can be unactive. Now should work fine.
[*] Fixed bug: Previously, sometimes ability effect applied to the character forever and this was able to cause some bugs.
[*] Fixed bug: Max Health Addition abilities not restore full health on select anymore.
[*] Level up mechanism was changed a bit, now it not pauses game process when you level up, instead, you can open this menu by key in time, when it better for you.
[*] Font on the level bar was improved, should be more "readable".
[*] Player healthbar size increased and added damage receive effect, to allow player better understand when he was hitted by an enemy.
[*] New abilities were added.
[*] Two new enemy types were added.
[*] Leviathans now drop card with a Bonus skill.
[*] Ally drones AI was reworked to follow player character.
[*] Some enemies spawn balance, new enemies were added into the spawn.
[*] Better abilities descriptions, more numbers info was added. Some skills icons were improved.
[*] Summon abilities were rebalanced to be more powerful.
[*] Now "reroll" button on Ability Select Screen is more fair and gives you always new skills, not just randomed again.
[*] New achievements were added.
[*] Save files moved to the better directory.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.21 released!
notes.content:
This update focuses on polishing existing content and adding new content - the chances of getting current abilities have been redesigned and more new abilities have been added. The game's internal algorithms have been heavily redesigned to allow add new content more efficiently and balance gameplay easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/81f2b74f9bc451158707aca75e46c640da0b4310.gif[/img]

[b]Changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Evade now not causes damage sound and effect
[*] Fixed bug: Laser rifle was dealing no damage to the closest targets in 1.0.20. Now it should be fine.
[*] Fixed bug: Knockback of an explosion damage previously can be calculated wrong if there were several targets.
[*] New Abilities were added, old ones were reworked a bit.
[*] New crate type was added, it contains random bonuses for the character.
[*] Enemies spawn balance was seriously improved (compared to 1.0.20).
[*] Enemies spawn points now generated automatically, which allows me to design bigger maps and do it more efficiently.
[*] Locations were extended, now there more space to move and escape enemies.
[*] Healer drones were balanced a bit.
[*] First Leviathan AI was improved a bit.
[*] Grapple Hook now allows to jump after character is near grapple point. It is increases Grapple Hook usability a lot.
[*] Drop chances balance was changed a bit.
[*] Projectiles of the first shooting enemies made more noticeable.
[*] Improved AI of the ally units and enemy units too.
[*] Balanced characters a bit (for example, Red now has small regeneration instead of zero regeneration).
[*] Now, when player character on low HP, more noticeable screen effect appears.
[*] New achievement was added.
[*] A lot of inner code and algorithms improvements and reworks.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.20 released!
notes.content:
It's a pretty big update. The game completing process and the mechanism of enemies appearing has been greatly changed. Leviathans now have their own arenas to fight, enemies spawn now is time-based, not wave, new Upgrades were added. Now it should be more interesting to play. We will be adding more content in future updates!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Sometimes slot for Active ability was locked on Upgrades Selection screen.
[*] Fixed bug: Blaster module projectiles previously were hitting the walls. Now it not happens.
[*] Fixed bug: Grenade Drop ability grenade was collided with player character. Now it not happens.
[*] Fixed bug: Jump Platform physical force was different sometimes and jump was failed. Now it pushes player to same height every time.
[*] Fixed bug: Ally Turrets AI still bad in previous version. Now it should be better.
[*] Leviathans now can be found on the separated arenas using Teleport.
[*] Was fully reworked spawn mechanism and now it is time-based, not wave-based like before.
[*] Jump platforms now not require to press Use key, them just work when player enters it.
[*] All Planet were extended a bit.
[*] Added something like "objectives", which will help you to understand, what to do next.
[*] Nanomachines effect now shown only targets, which will spawn your ally NPC.
[*] Nanomachines Drones now prefer to fly in zone where them was spawned, if no enemy target near.
[*] Some new Upgrades were added.
[*] Some visual effects were improved, added some new effects.
[*] Grenade Drop ability was balanced to make more damage.
[*] Healing items now taking only if the player character has not full HP.
[*] Added reload time on skills icons.
[*] Improved Upgrade selection screen for a bit.
[*] Player character spawn on Planets now randomized a bit.
[*] Were made some code optimizations, game now should work better with bigger amounts of NPCs on screen.
[*] Localizations fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.19 released!
notes.content:
This update is aimed at improving balance and fixes. Also, more abilities have been added to the enhancements menu. Added a new mechanic - [b]Evasion[/b], and a related ability.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Sometimes can be a problem with percent display in Upgrades description.
[*] Fixed bug: Sometimes, Nanomachines ability drones can be spawned in menu. :)
[*] Fixed bug: More Turrets ability can previously remove alive turret sometimes when player was placing a new one.
[*] Fixed bug: Plague monsters falling below the ground. Also, sometimes them were spawned in the ground.
[*] Added more Upgrades and Abilities. Improved Fire and Poison upgrades branches, also some work done on other Upgrades types.
[*] Added Evasion mechanic.
[*] Replaced items take sounds, players feedback says that previous were annoying.
[*] Improved Ally Turrets AI.
[*] Optimized work of all ally units AI checks, sometimes before it can make fps drops.
[*] Nanomachines buff now has its oiwn effect on targets.
[*] Better damage receive effects for Plague Monsters.
[*] Repair Kit ability was balanced.
[*] Balanced first planet enemies spawn a bit.
[*] Laser Rifle was reworked and now its damage decreases for each hit target in a line. Balance was reworked for this change.
[*] Blaster and Plasma Moon balance was reworked a bit. 
[*] Other balance changes, fixes, etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.18
notes.content:
This update is aimed at introducing new content and improving existing content. Quite a few new abilities have been added, now they depend on each other in a more meaningful way.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Laser rifle with multi-shot to same target were dealing damage only from one laser. Now all lasers damage target.
[*] Fixed bug: Blaster Module and Auto-Aimed Rockets not every time selected target to attack.
[*] Added some of new Upgrades and Abilities.
[*] Green character now have its own unique passive ability too!
[*] Balanced Survival Kit ability a bit.
[*] Abilities minor balance changes.
[*] Improved NPCs AI for a bit.
[*] Improved turret place effect. Also, turret visual (sprite) is now more noticeable.
[*] New healing effect for Healing Drone NPCs.
[*] Changed physical movement a bit.
[*] Added Experience drop for Leviathans.
[*] Some optimization for situations when a lot of effects on map, etc.
[*] A lot of inner code improvements and extensions. It allows me to implement new upgrades and more complex combinations a lot easier than before.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.17
notes.content:
This update is aimed at expanding content and improving gameplay. The main feature - most characters now have their own unique passive ability! Also, other new abilities were added and the game was balanced, as well as a number of fixes were made.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Abilities previously can be used if clicked on Upgrades screen or Game Over/Victory screen.
[*] Fixed bug: On gamepad in pause menu was skipped options button when navigating up.
[*] Most of characters now have its own passive abilities! Now it gives more affect to gameplay by using different characters. Them also were balanced a bit. I'll continue to improve characters and trying to make them more unique.
[*] Was added more abilities and upgrades. Some upgrades drop was balanced.
[*] Now prices in Loadout menu is lower by default, but increase with each unlock. You can unlock first items you're more interested, not low-priced as before.
[*] Plasma Moon weapon now balanced better.
[*] Classic cursor is now shown in any menus instead of Aim cursor.
[*] Aim cursor visual was improved and made more noticeable.
[*] Now cursor can be controlled when gamepad controller is connected.
[*] Arrow keys now can be use for movement too.
[*] Camera is now have offset move in the aim direction for gamepad controls.
[*] Pause menu now can be closed with same button it opens (Escape or gamepad Menu button).
[*] Other fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.content:
And another update! And how do I find time for real life? :D Nevermind, this update has a lot of fixes and gameplay balance adjustments.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: when were several damage hits in the same game tick, was applied only first one.
[*] Fixed bug: Loot Crates collecting were required to complete Area. Now you need only elliminate all enemies.
[*] Fixed bug: Worms were stuck on corners sometimes. Now it should happen much less frequently or not happen at all. But I continue to improve movement algorithms.
[*] Fixed bug: Very rarely Leviathan can not be spawned and other NPCs too.
[*] Fixed bug: Split Shoot Module and Energy Burst damage change was affecting player damage a wrong percent.
[*] Shotgun and Plasma Moon weapons knockback is increased. 
[*] Plasma Moon damage is decreased. 
[*] Shotgun damage and reload speed is decreased a bit. For shotgun it still be very good since bugfix, described above.
[*] Berserk ability reload is increased by 1 sec.
[*] On Loadout screen you now can see weapon Knockback parameter info.
[*] Periodic damage/heal now has delay before start affecting target.
[*] Balanced player leveling a bit.
[*] Other changes.
[*] Jet Modules and Auto-aimed rocket effects were improved.
[*] Fixed conflicting buttons on gamepad controller. Duplicated movement controls to a D-pad.
[*] Modding: Loadout modding was added as preview. Its API will be changed in future!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.15
notes.content:
This update is mainly dedicated to visual improvements and small fixes. Most of the changes are made inside the game and will not be noticeable to players at this stage. Also the support for modding has been expanded.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Upgrades window previously can be opened when player click Exit button in Pause Menu, and game stuck in this state.
[*] Fixed bug: Controls localization in Settings wasn't work.
[*] Improved first planet decorations a bit.
[*] Jump Platform visual was improved, made it more noticeable.
[*] Added player spawn effects.
[*] Inner game code improvements, which allows me to add more new features.
[*] Menu button sound changed (there were some feedback that previous sound is annoying).
[*] Changed heal screen fx a bit, to be more different from damage receive fx.
[*] Fixed some sorting order for sprites.
[*] In Upgrades menu buttons now become active after ~half of a second passed, to prevent unwanted player keyboard/gamepad input.
[*] Modding: Custom projectiles are supported now. You can make your own projectile, or change weapon projectile to any game-ready ones.
[*] Localization fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.14
notes.content:
This update fixes another critical bug and introduces a new feature - [b]Auto-Shoot[/b]. It can be enabled in the [b]Settings[/b] menu.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: When Start in menu was clicked twice, it can stop work sometimes.
[*] Fixed bug: Player character have spawned with not full health on next location, if he has abilities, increasing his health.
[*] Added Controls tab to the Settings menu. It explains game controls and contains a new Auto-Shoot parameter.
[*] First Leviathan was balanced and now stronger than before.
[*] First Leviathan now has visual for his second phase.
[*] Some abilities, changed reload-time, were balanced.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.content:
This is an urgent update with fixes of the Loadout problem in 1.0.12.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: problem with loadout after exiting to menu after death.
[*] Fixed bug: settings screen ingame - audio panel was broken.
[*] Gamepad aim controls improved a lot.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.12
notes.content:
And I have another update for you. This time a little more content and visual improvements to the game and interface, something like "Quality of Life" improvements.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Loadout selection was saved not every time.
[*] Settings menu now have better design, especially for gamepad controllers.
[*] Added several new Upgrades. Try them. :)
[*] Shotgun was balanced, behavior and visuals were changed a bit.
[*] Re-roll price increase was balanced to be more affordable.
[*] Start Worm enemies was balanced to be able easier to avoid by player.
[*] Explosive skill was balanced a bit, now you can see radius of already placed explosives.
[*] Added comparison indicators to the Loadout screen. also now you can see ability reload time on the Loadout screen. 
[*] Extended first planet area a bit.
[*] Other minor fixes and inner code improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.11
notes.content:
Another update. This time I fixed some wrong ability descriptions, also was added several new gameplay mechanics and made few balance adjustments. The current version should be more playable and balanced than previous ones.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug: Wrong stats for Cold Fury ability. Also balanced it a bit.
[*] Fixed bug: Loot previously sometimes was stuck in the ground.
[*] Fixed bug: Controller skip menu element in main menu.
[*] Fixed bug: Pause menu now can not be called while shown other menu like Upgrades window.
[*] Fixed bug: Last Leviathan collisions.
[*] Added numbers and percents into Upgrades descriptions. In future more upgrades will be described like this.
[*] Added jump platforms to levels.
[*] Added crates with basic loot, which will randomely spawn on map. I want to add more content and loot to these crates in future.
[*] Blaster module now have auto-aimed projectiles with lower fly speed.
[*] Made interaction effect for objects more noticeable.
[*] Added info to interface about how much more Active abilities you can have.
[*] Balanced second and third location spawn rate.
[*] Other minor changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
We received negative feedback about the difficulty at the beginning of the game and too close enemy spawning. This update is primarily aimed at correcting these problems.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skills controls on keyboard moved from ZXCVF to QWERTY.
[*] Now enemies will not spawn too close to player.
[*] First location balance was corrected (simplified a bit).
[*] Added some delays between waves to prevent too much enemies at once.
[*] Art of initial worms was changed to be more noticeable in map environment.
[*] Fixed bug with camera shake in pause menu.
[*] Added aura effect for Cold and Heat implants.
[*] Fixed bug when pause menu locked transition between maps.
[*] Now after death and returning to menu, Loadout screen will be shown, to allow you start new "run" easier.
[*] Better keys font for abilities interface.
[*] Added attack effect for melee enemies to allow player better see when him was hit by an enemy.
[*] Minor changes (in art, user interface, etc).
[*] Fixes for Ukrainian localization.
[*] Fixed Controller minor text problem.
[*] Fixed Closing options in pause menu with controller made game stuck.
[/list]

Hope it will improve your game experience! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hi! Today I have a new update with some game improvements and enhancements.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Was added new Upgrade ability - Gravity module. Try it! :)
[*] Passive abilities now shown on UI too - it will help you better understand your build.
[*] Damage to player now shown with damage numbers with different color.
[*] Fixed bug with Attack modifiers and Grenade Launcher.
[*] Minor art and UI improvements.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Added Ukrainian language (as preview, will be improved in next versions).
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Some game updates:
[list]
[*] Segmented NPCs AI was improved and now it should be more interesting.
[*] Bug fix: AI problems of Flying NPCs.
[*] Balance fixes: Healer NPCs now easier to destroy, but heals their targets more than before. Also, they not healing other Healer NPCs now.
[*] Bug fix: Auto-aimed rockets were flying to the Ally Turret sometimes.
[*] Enemies now will not spawn too close to player.
[*] Minor improvements in user interface.
[*] "Reach" achievement fix.
[/list]

notes.title: First patch [1.0.7]
notes.content:
The game just came out, and there is already an update. :D

According to the feedback, some things have been fixed:
- Improved balance. More money drops from enemies.
- Drops from enemies are now attracted at a small distance.
- Small fixes.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Echo Storm release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583518/ac58ddd66c17c5e20fdf72e48918fb7069d56aa0.png[/img]

The game is available now on the Steam store page! I've been going at it for about a year, and now it's finally done.

Enjoy the game!

[h2]What's next[/h2]
The release does not mean the end of development. More game content is planned.

[h3]Abilities[/h3]
More abilities for the character, so you can make even more unique combinations.

[h3]Gameplay balance[/h3]
Balance tweaks - I will be adjusting the difficulty of the game based on players feedback.

[h3]Mods and maps[/h3]
Modding support - one of the main objectives, to enable players to create their own levels and add new content to the game (weapons, characters, enemies, etc.). It's too early to say anything about it yet, but there is progress and you can already make simple mods.

[h3]Localization[/h3]
I plan to add more translations into different languages. Deutsche and Українська at first, next maybe more.
